claims.text: Hyperlocal delivery of groceries and daily essentials in under ten minutes from small dark stores, operating in one city neighbourhood cluster.
Risks recorded by the fund: Capital-intensive model that only works at density. Well-funded incumbents with deep pockets. Contribution margin negative on the data shown. Customer loyalty unproven.

Partner assessment of founders from the meeting: Varun Malhotra and Dev Sethi, two former operations managers at a quick-commerce company. Their operational knowledge was real and detailed; they knew picking times, rider utilisation and wastage by category. They were also visibly energetic. But when pressed, neither could describe a path to profitability that did not depend on a large raise to reach density, and they treated that as someone else's problem to solve.
